purpose: Measure a local model, select a configuration, then finish with a task performed by that same model and configuration. Preview remains explicitly simulated until the device bridge is connected.

visual_system.typography: local system sans serif; monospace for metrics
visual_system.motion: screen entrance, chart reveal, file arrival; respects reduced motion
visual_system.navigation: one persistent three-step navigation; no secondary sidebar

screens.headline: Tune your model. For this machine.
screens.purpose: Identify the recorded target and model before exploring calibration.

screens.headline: Choose how it runs.
screens.purpose: Compare one metric at a time and inspect the selected configuration.
screens.ranking: Only completed comparable trials; TTFT ascending, throughput descending; keep ties.
screens.failure_state: Keep failed/incomplete rows visible with no numeric bar.
screens.metric_help: Show one explanation for the active measure above the chart, define its unit, and state that rankings are per measure rather than an overall winner.

screens.headline: Your model. In action.
screens.purpose: The demo finale: carry the selected model and settings into a file task, show its visible result, and expose measured evidence when the device is connected.
content: authoritative workspace returned by task provider
scenarios: move final file while preserving draft
screens.completion: Leave the result on the final screen; no fourth step or automatic return to the start.
live_behavior: Verify exact model/runtime hashes, configuration and fixture before inference.
Apply selected settings before running; do not infer application from selection.
Only display timings with a source and scope; missing remains unavailable.
Task checks require intent, action and file postconditions, not valid JSON alone.
Handle clarification and failed checks separately from success.
No silent preview fallback on device failure.
Invalidate prior task results when selection changes.

rules: Never present animated recorded results as a live benchmark.
Never use invented performance numbers or treat null as zero.
Never label screening gains as confirmed speedups.
Never infer verified NPU computation from a requested or reported device alone.
No duplicate navigation, metric-card grid, unrelated marketing sections, or camera/Arduino workflow.
Preserve the same three-screen UX when a live provider is added, with explicit mode and evidence states.
One persistent mode badge. Benchmark evidence is available from the footer; task evidence belongs with the task result.
Do not animate the whole screen again on every state update.
The file task illustrates the tuner result; it is not a separate file management product.
